normalizations: Join raster line wraps; keep wording, case, punctuation and values as printed.
Omit cover drawing, wordmark, printed page numbers, US/English page badges and the printed contents page.
The cover badge 'V2' is shown as 'Version: V2'.
Customer Service icons (wrench, person, envelope) are carried by the shared warranty component styling rather than cropped.
Back-cover contact icons (phone, envelope, house) are dropped; the contact lines remain native text.
Shared callout labels drop a trailing colon ('Tip:' → 'Tip'); shared Sphinx typography may render straight apostrophes as typographic ones.
Cover 'Contact us:' lines stay in the introduction; the back-cover entities are two pages, JACKERY MEXICO S.A. DE C.V. then JACKERY INC., in printed order.
Printed 'www.jackery.com' is the visible link text of https://www.jackery.com.
